name: Modular Sum Singularity
description: Replaced the matrix determinant condition (which algebraically simplifies to e_u != e_v) with the condition that (e_u + 2 e_v) must not be a multiple of 3. For values in {1,2,3}, this is exactly equivalent to e_u != e_v, but it breaks pattern matching that maps the problem to graph 3-coloring, defeating degree-based vertex ordering heuristics.
